nvs_version: EPA invitrodb v3.3 (2020), DSSTox structure snapshot 2018-10-17
binary_policy: Representative gsid_rep=1 hitc=0/1 observations, conflicts masked across compound/assay
potency_policy: Representative hitc=1, finite unflagged uM measurements; pAC50=6-modl_ga where modl_ga=log10(uM)
assay_policy: Keep NVS original aeid and assay name separate from all prior source heads
identity_policy: Exact standardized compounds deduplicated; all challenge connectivity excluded
